subject: POC/trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC
messages:
From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial call — trial next steps

Thanks for the call today, Marissa — that was super helpful. Quick recap and a couple of asks as we prepare for a POC:

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for customer-facing summarization and routing use cases. Success criteria we care about: 1) median response latency < 400ms for 2k token context, 2) token cost < $0.002 per 1k tokens for production-like load, 3) accuracy on our evaluation prompts >= 92% agreement with human labels.
- Scope: 2 LLM-powered flows (summarization + intent routing), ~30k monthly active queries during test load.
- Environment options we discussed: hosted Redwood API trial (fastest), dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity, deterministic perf), or VPC trial (private network, audit logs).

As security/compliance owners, we need a short checklist for each environment: network requirements, data retention settings, and encryption/KMS details. Can you send a proposed timeline and who from your side will own infra setup and SSO/KMS coordination?

Thanks,
Sophie
Security & Product, FinHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@finhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial call — trial next steps

Hi Sophie — great to meet you and thanks for the clear success criteria. Per your ask, attached is a short POC plan and the network checklist. Summary below and proposed next steps: 

1) Recommended POC path: start with a hosted Redwood trial for fast validation (we can provision an isolated org/project and sample configs), then move to a dedicated sandbox if you need guaranteed latency under load, and finalize on a VPC trial only if required for regulatory controls. Rationale: hosted lets you iterate quickly; dedicated gives you performance guarantees; VPC adds network isolation and KMS control but lengthens setup time.

2) Ownership: Rishi (cc'd) will be the primary technical owner for Redwood side (provisioning, test workloads, perf tuning). From FinHealth, would be great if Tom is the infra lead to coordinate VPN/firewall rules and KMS.

3) Timeline (proposed):
   - Week 0 (this week): sign trial SOW and share network details
   - Week 1: hosted trial provisioned + test dataset ingested; quick smoke tests
   - Week 2: run sustained load tests and evaluate latency/cost; iterate on batching/configs
   - Week 3: decision point — continue hosted, transition to dedicated sandbox, or start VPC onboarding (if selected, add 2-3 weeks for network certs and KMS integration)

4) Success criteria: copy of your three bullets — we'll run the eval harness you provide and share token-level cost/latency breakdowns.

Please review attached trial plan and the network checklist; if that looks good, confirm SOW sign and we will send onboarding access.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@finhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial call — trial next steps

Thanks Marissa — plan looks reasonable. A couple of clarifying Qs from infra:

- For hosted trial: what IP ranges should we whitelist? Will there be a stable outbound address for callbacks/webhooks?
- For dedicated sandbox: do you provide a single-tenant GPU pool with pinned capacity, or is it reserved instances on shared hosts? Need to understand performance isolation guarantees.
- For VPC trial: what KMS providers do you support (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, customer HSM)? Also want to see sample audit log format.

I can be the point for network configuration. Once we have the answers I can schedule time with our security team for the sign-off.

Thanks,
Tom
Principal Infra Engineer, FinHealth
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@finhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial call — trial next steps

Hi Tom — answering your infra questions below:

- Hosted trial IPs: we will provide a list of IP ranges to whitelist for the hosted control plane and ingestion endpoints. For outgoing webhooks or callbacks we recommend using our webhook relay endpoint; if you need fixed egress IPs we can set up a NATed egress for the dedicated sandbox, but hosted trials typically rely on TLS callbacks to our relay. I attached the short network-checklist.xlsx with specific ports and domains.

- Dedicated sandbox: this is a reserved-capacity pool — you get dedicated GPU nodes for your org (not noisy-neighbor shared hosts). We offer SLA-backed latency targets for the reserved pools and can guarantee CPU/GPU allocation based on the commit.

- VPC trial: we support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys in GCP and Azure via Cloud KMS integrations. We also support bringing your own HSM (via partner integrations) for enterprise contracts. Audit logs can be exported in JSONL format to your S3/GCS bucket — sample schema is in the attached trial plan PDF.

Next steps from our side: I'll spin up a hosted trial org and share creds (limited access) by EOD Thur. If you want the dedicated sandbox estimate we'll run sizing based on your expected sustained qps — Marissa, can you flag the deal for dedicated pricing if FinHealth picks that path?

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@finhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial call — trial next steps

Perfect — thanks for the details, team. Sophie/Tom — next concrete items to keep momentum: 

1) FinHealth: confirm you want us to provision the hosted trial org (fast path) or pause and request dedicated sandbox estimate. Reply here with preferred path by Friday 03/06.
2) If hosted: Tom, please share a single IP for whitelist or confirm you will use our webhook relay (see network-checklist.xlsx).
3) FinHealth: send the evaluation prompt set (CSV) and the list of golden labels for the accuracy check. We'll wire this into the eval harness.

Internal note: Vivek — please prepare a dedicated sandbox pricing SKU and rough capacity recommendation for 30k MAU, 2k context, and the two flows. I will follow up with the commercial team if FinHealth requests dedicated.

Attaching: 20260304-poc-trial-plan.pdf and network-checklist.xlsx

Thanks all — looking forward to next steps.

— Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
